sources: E-Switch FS5700 Series pushbutton switch, rev. 4.2.2018, LCSC's copy for C6859268 https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/a62749f9229fcc13ab62da99737b420b.pdf?productCode=C6859268, read 2026-10-31 (e-switch.com is not reachable from here)

p. 1 specifications: contact rating 1 A @ 9 VDC (v_max_v 9, i_contact_max_a 1.0), contact resistance 50 mΩ initial (r_on_ohm), operating temperature −10 … 70 °C, 3 pole alternate action; part number configurator: FS5700, 3P, L = alternate action, T2, B2, M2 = PCB pins, Q = silver, E = epoxy

p. 4 (triple pole): 3PDT schematic – commons 2, 5, 8 against 1/3, 4/6, 7/9, drawn on 1, 4, 7 (throw_a); PCB layout the 3 × 3 grid, commons in the middle row – as the designs' footprint FS57003PLT2B2M2QE:SW_FS57003PLT2B2M2QE (pads 2, 5, 8 at y = 0)
JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31 (edakit part search): C6859268 FS57003PLT2B2M2QE, Extended Part, no stock
